title: Pharmacological bioactivity of Ceratonia siliqua pulp extract: in vitro screening and molecular docking analysis, implication of Keap-1/Nrf2/NF-kB pathway.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究角豆提取物的药理活性，分子对接仅针对Keap-1/Nrf2/NF-kB蛋白通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Inflammation is interfaced with various metabolic disorders. Ceratonia siliqua (CS) has a higher pharmaceutical purpose. The research aimed to investigate the biofunction of CS pulp aqueous extract (CS-PAE) with an emphasis on its integrated computational approaches as opposed to different specific receptors contributing to inflammation. The extract was assessed for its chemical and phenolic components via GC-MS, LC-MS, HPLC, and total phenolic and flavonoid content. In vitro, bioactivities and molecular docking were analyzed. Findings indicate that CS-PAE demonstrated higher scavenging activities of nitric oxide, 1,1-diphenyl-2-picrylhydrazyl radical, superoxide anion, hydrogen peroxide, and anti-lipid peroxidation (IC(50) values were 5.29, 3.04, 0.63, 7.35 and 9.6 mg/dl, respectively). The extract revealed potent inhibition of RBCs hemolysis, acetylcholine esterase, monoamine oxidase-B, and alpha-glucosidase enzymes (IC(50) was 13.44, 9.31, 2.45, and 1.5 mg/dl, respectively). The extract exhibited a cytotoxic effect against prostate cancer Pc3, liver cancer HepG2, colon cancer Caco2, and lung cancer A549 cell lines. Moreover, CS-PAE owned higher antiviral activity against virus A and some bacteria. When contrasting data from molecular docking, it was reported that both apigenin-7-glucoside and rutin in CS-PAE have a good affinity toward the Keap-1/Nrf2/ NF-kB pathway. In conclusion, CS-PAE showed promise in therapeutic activity in metabolic conditions.
abstract_zh: 炎症与多种代谢性疾病密切相关。角豆（Ceratonia siliqua, CS）具有较高的药用价值。本研究旨在探讨CS果肉水提物（CS-PAE）的生物功能，重点通过整合计算生物学方法，研究其与参与炎症的不同特异性受体的相互作用。采用GC-MS、LC-MS、HPLC及总酚和总黄酮含量测定法评估提取物的化学成分和酚类组成。进行了体外生物活性分析和分子对接研究。结果表明，CS-PAE对一氧化氮、1,1-二苯基-2-苦基肼自由基、超氧阴离子、过氧化氢表现出较高的清除活性，并具有抗脂质过氧化作用（IC(50)值分别为5.29、3.04、0.63、7.35和9.6 mg/dl）。提取物对红细胞溶血、乙酰胆碱酯酶、单胺氧化酶-B和α-葡萄糖苷酶表现出强效抑制作用（IC(50)分别为13.44、9.31、2.45和1.5 mg/dl）。提取物对前列腺癌Pc3、肝癌HepG2、结肠癌Caco2和肺癌A549细胞系具有细胞毒性作用。此外，CS-PAE对A型病毒和某些细菌表现出较高的抗病毒活性。对比分子对接数据发现，CS-PAE中的芹菜素-7-葡萄糖苷和芦丁对Keap-1/Nrf2/NF-kB通路具有良好的亲和力。总之，CS-PAE在代谢性疾病治疗活性方面显示出潜力。
